scope: Astra664abe 91.075–1671.409 route42; duplicate-track hypotheses consolidated using <0.5m same-color proximity; not proof of other-session layout
status: Measured whole-course source-session inventory hypothesis; unseen/occluded markers and physical identity remain unverified. No absence inferred from missing fits.
method: 565 actual registered source-session images, native color proposals, manual four-view semantic crop review; >=5views >=4deg RANSAC triangulation, 2px assumed ray localization. Two blue closing-row seeds only guide ray search, not final coordinates.
uncertainty: Conditional covariance holds SfM camera poses/intrinsics exact. Correlated camera/map drift, scale, lens/body reference, source correspondence and physical edges are unmeasured; values are not survey confidence bounds.
